For pull request review, the following considerations are important:

Description vs. Implementation:
  - PR has a description
  - Description matches implementation
  - Implementation is documented (unless already covered)
Implementation/Code:
  - Correctness
  - Clarity
  - Testing (unless already covered)
  - Design / performance impacts

Don't waste bandwidth on style-related items, or indent levels. Use
the user's PR description (if provided) and your own analysis to form
a high level description of the change set, and its purpose.  Summarize
the changes to each file in a table.
